## Fast Orchestrator
One Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite call, real MCP evidence, same-model self-review and explicit human approval in Python. No agent loops or invented tool evidence. Set the Backend Header on the webhook, MCP Header on the three MCP clients and Google credential on Gemini One Call. Path: fast-internship-coach. Latency must be measured after import; five seconds is a target, not a guarantee.
